title: 第7章 陈丧尽天良小草第8章 出任CEO迎娶白富美走上人生巅峰
slug: 御兽别人鉴定都是骗你开神兽
content_zh:
;;
陈小草短暂的愣了一瞬。
她这不是在帮摊主促成生意吗？
当事人不说话，怎么他这个卖家先跳出来了？
摊主的话也让乔简心里直打鼓。
刚才他只是一味的在想这枚蛋能不能开出b级御兽，一度忘了品种的问题。
直到摊主出言提醒，他这才警觉。
妈的，差点就被这小丫头片子给坑了。
虽然看不到乔简的神色，但陈小草依旧从他的语气里听出了些许防备和怨怼。
“主播你这就不厚道了啊。”
“我每次和你连线，都是先打赏一波，而且什么都不用你做。”
“我们无冤无仇的，你为什么要害我？”
陈小草麻了。
不是，我不是，我没有，别乱说啊！
被他误会事小，要是第一个‘饵’都下不去，她还怎么赚到一只御兽蛋的钱啊！
“大哥，你误会了，我只是能够确认，这枚御兽蛋能开出来b级御兽而已。”
“如果你不放心，那我重新给你选一个蛋就好了。”
“反正。。。”
陈小草话没说完，乔简就直接打断道。
“好了，不要说了。”

乔简苦涩一笑。
自己真是被欲望蒙蔽了双眼。
上次的事情明显就是一个巧合。
恰好自己就在那个摊位，恰好这个小主播随便指了一个御兽蛋，又恰好，这枚御兽蛋是骑士团刚好需要的东西。
三个巧合在一起，也算不上多小的概率。
那些副本中，比这概率还小的事情经常发生。
自己是被‘错过奉献骑士团’这个天大的机缘给迷住了眼。
这才会把一切都归结于这个小主播的身上
感觉彻底‘清醒’过来的乔简，眼睛里绽放出坚定的光芒。
他扯了扯嘴角，一本正经的道。
“主播，你这样做是不对的。”
“玄学开蛋，无据可依。当然，帝国虽然没有禁止这件事，但你永远不知道，你的随口一句胡诌，会给需要契约御兽的御兽师带来多大的损失。”
“有的人，奋斗了大半辈子，只能在升级5星兽师的时候攒够一个御兽蛋的钱。”
“他们怀着虔诚的心，想要通过一个御兽蛋逆天改命。”
“可结果呢？被你们这些骗子骗了钱不说，一旦开出来的御兽蛋太差，他们可能就会在副本中身死。”
“我真的不知道你是怎么能狠下这个心，来做这种丧尽天良的事情的。”
乔简目光灼灼，脸上一副痛心疾首的表情，继续道。
“古语有云，放下屠刀，回头是岸。”
“小主播，你去找个正经工作吧，不要到时候见习骑士找上了门，你连哭的地方都没有。”
陈·丧尽天良·小草：。。。

要不是她的系统能看到具体信息，她都差点以为自己真的是什么无恶不作的骗子了。
“不是，大哥，我真没骗你啊！”
陈小草有些急了。
直播间人数突破了她直播以来的历史新高，足足有8个人。
现在还有一个连麦的‘饵料’。

Chen Xiaocao was stunned for a moment.
Isn't she helping the stall owner to promote business?
The person involved didn’t say anything, so why did he, the seller, jump out first?
The stall owner's words also made Qiao Jian's heart beat.
Just now, he was just thinking about whether this egg could produce a B-level beast, and he forgot about the breed for a while.
It wasn't until the stall owner warned him that he became alert.
Damn, I was almost fooled by this little girl's movie.
Although he couldn't see Qiao Jian's expression, Chen Xiaocao still heard some defensiveness and resentment in his tone.
"Anchor, you are not being kind."
"Every time I connect with you, I give you a reward first, and you don't have to do anything."
"We have no enmity, why do you want to harm me?"
Chen Xiaocao felt numb.
No, I'm not, I didn't, don't talk nonsense!
It was a trivial matter to be misunderstood by him. If she couldn't get the first 'bait', how could she make money from a beast-controlling egg?
"Brother, you misunderstood. I can only confirm that this beast-taming egg can produce B-level beast-taming eggs."
"If you're worried, I'll just choose another egg for you."
"Anyway..."
Before Chen Xiaocao finished speaking, Qiao Jian interrupted directly.
"Okay, stop talking."
Qiao Jian smiled bitterly.
I was really blinded by desire.
What happened last time was obviously a coincidence.
It just so happened that he was at that stall, and the little anchor happened to point at a beast-taming egg. It just so happened that this beast-taming egg was exactly what the knights needed.
The probability of three coincidences together is not very small.
In those copies, things less likely than this often happen.
I was fascinated by the great opportunity of 'missing the Knights of Consecration'.
Only then can everything be attributed to this little anchor
Qiao Jian, who felt completely 'awakened', had a determined light in her eyes.
He twitched the corners of his mouth and said seriously.
"Anchor, what you are doing is wrong."
"There is no basis for metaphysics. Of course, although the empire has not banned this matter, you never know how much loss your casual nonsense will bring to the beast masters who need to contract beast masters."
"Some people, after struggling for most of their lives, can only save enough money for a beast-controlling egg when they upgrade to a 5-star beast master."
"With pious hearts, they want to use a beast-controlling egg to change their destiny."
"But what's the result? Not to mention the money they defrauded by you scammers, once the beast-control eggs are too bad, they may die in the dungeon."
"I really don't know how you could be so cruel as to do such a heartless thing."
Qiao Jian continued with burning eyes and a heartbroken expression on her face.
"As the old saying goes, put down the butcher's knife and look back."
"Little anchor, you should find a serious job. Don't let the trainee knight come to your door. You won't even have a place to cry."
Chen · Losing one’s conscience · Xiaocao:. . .
If her system hadn't been able to see the specific information, she would have almost thought she was some evil liar.
"No, brother, I really didn't lie to you!"
Chen Xiaocao was a little anxious.
The number of people in the live broadcast room exceeded the all-time high since her live broadcast, with a total of 8 people.
Now there is a Lianmai ‘bait’.
